messages:
Raya Cole: Quick note from CS: several tenants saw their quota counters spike after opting into v2. They read the console 'v1 deprecated' badge and assumed nothing changed. In reality router fell back to v2 for some requests and quotas were attributed to v2 buckets. Need clearer attribution and small fixes.

Matt Weiss: Agreed. Root cause: quota-service used configured_route (control plane) to pick bucket. Router emits decision metadata but quota-service ignores it. Minimal fix: prefer router-provided decision header `X-Route-Decision` when present.

Olga Ivanova: UX: show "Quota attribution" on tenant usage card with two tiny numbers: attributed_to_configured / attributed_to_active. Hover explains: "configured = control-plane default; active = what runtime actually served." That should reduce support noise.

Raya Cole: Also we should avoid surprising billing. Short-term mitigation: on migration page show "expected quota delta" and allow tenant to enable "billing hold for 30d" which prevents invoicing differences while we reconcile factors. Do we have legal ok for holds? I'll ping finance.

Matt Weiss: Implementation notes: router will add `X-Route-Decision: <variant>;id=<decision_id>`; quota daemon will parse and prefer variant if header present. We'll log decision_id for correlation. Backward compatibility: if header missing, fallback to configured route.

Olga Ivanova: Telemetry: emit metric `active_attribution_pct` per-tenant. Alert if active attribution > 10% for >1h for tenants still marked as v1. Console should display a warning and a one-click guide to test on v2.

deploybot: router v5 canary deployed to beta cluster with decision header enabled for 10% traffic.

Raya Cole: Action items: Matt -> quota-service change + logs, Olga -> console small UI showing attribution split + banner copy, Raya -> coordinate finance/legal about billing hold. We'll reconvene after canary.
